newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank says dollar at right level.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank says dollar at right level.

text.p: Austrian central bank director Adolf Wala said on Tuesday the U.S. dollar was currently at a level which was in line with its actual purchasing power.
"I believe that the dollar rate is in a range which is about in line with its purchasing power parity," Wala told reporters.
He added he expected the dollar to fluctuate in a band between 1.60 and 1.75 marks for the time being. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
